probableCause: The test cannot reach a database on localhost:54329. That is the local-only default port in the test (db.port), so in an environment where the database listens elsewhere the connection is refused. It is a configuration/environment problem, not a code defect.
evidence: ConnectException: Connection refused while connecting to localhost:54329.
DB_PORT defaults to 54329 when -Ddb.port is not set.
The URL test with port 5432 passes, so only the configured port differs.

possibleSolutions.solution: Pass -Ddb.port with the port the CI database listens on, or read the port from the environment.
tradeoffs: Needs the CI configuration to export the port.

confidenceReason: The refused connection and the default port are explicit, but the port the CI database really uses is not in the context.
limitations: The CI database configuration was not provided.
